description: This file defines the ConsistentRingQueueBalancer class, which implements a stream queue balancer using consistent hashing via a ring range. It manages queue distribution based on ring ranges, subscribes to range changes, and provides functionality to initialize and retrieve queues.

classes.name: ConsistentRingQueueBalancer
classes.description: Implements a stream queue balancer using consistent hashing with a ring range, managing queue assignments and reacting to ring range changes.

methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ConsistentRingQueueBalancer with dependency injection.

methods.name: ConsistentRingQueueBalancer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ring range and subscribes to range change events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with a queue mapper, ensuring it implements the necessary interface.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the queues assigned to this node based on its ring range.
